idea-plugin.name: Jest Snapshot PII Audit
idea-plugin.description:
15 rules that find the real customer data your .snap files committed

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Jest Snapshot PII Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 15 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/jest-snapshot-pii-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/jest-snapshot-pii-audit

action.text: Jest Snapshot PII Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Jest Snapshot PII Audit on the file in the editor
